title: Move channel search from sidebar to center of main header
summary: The root ask was delivered: Search moved from the rail/sidebar to the centered main channel header in commit 34df74b. Later requests in the same thread to refine the compact pill, add visual depth/padding, and expand in place were also reported implemented in commits 588283c, 9757183, e4884ac, 2652dd6, and 0f05c63. The root placement change is integrated in current main history. The separate global-search feature task remains in review pending owner interaction; this is not evidence that the root placement ask remains open.
nextAction: Product Development Lead (task owner) should complete the task's existing owner interaction: try Search/Cmd-Ctrl+F, enter a term, open a result, and confirm the originating thread; then update that task's review status/evidence. No follow-up is needed for the root placement request.
evidence: Thread reply post_01a0e3ad-3dc7-72e1-8663-4b39536080c0 reports centered header placement in commit 34df74b, includes desktop screenshot, and reports typecheck, client layout checks, channel-browser tests 7/7, desktop and iPad-landscape screenshots.
Current repository history contains commit 34df74bd9ecff5462229d8d4390d4571a58992bd on main ancestry; commit changes ChannelBrowser and adds ChannelSearch.

Later thread posts report centered pill and expanded-in-place refinements in commits 588283c, 9757183, e4884ac, 2652dd6, and 0f05c63, with screenshots and focused checks as described by the implementer.

Current task task_01a0e340-1a73-70d9-91e9-574831032777 is in review; its done criteria include search invocation, all-readable-channel query, result navigation, and client checks. Its nextAction requests owner interaction with a result.
The related main-history feature commits include 623289d and b61c1a9 for structured and fuzzy channel search, but this review did not verify live UI behavior.
limitations: No browser/live UI verification performed in this review; the visual and check evidence is reported in thread/task records.
The review task's owner-level search-result interaction remains unconfirmed, so global search is implemented and integrated but not fully verified/released by this evidence.
Repository working tree is dirty with unrelated changes; conclusions rely on commit ancestry and task/thread evidence, not dirty-tree checks.
